summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Mini-Class - Making Inner Drawstrings for Pants Waistbands ## Introduction Hello everyone! Today, I will introduce to you how to make a drawstring on the inside of the waist. Now our pants are finished. ## Adding Drawstrings Next, we need to add two drawstrings to the inside of the waist to show the effect of the drawstring coming out of the hole and falling naturally from the inside out. ### Accessing Materials First of all, we look at the drawing window on the left and find the material. Double-click to open it. Next, find the drawstring and the drawstring folder. There are some related materials in the software. Here, we can choose the first drawstring file. Right-click to add it to the work area. ### Positioning the Drawstring Next, we use the positioning ball tool to move it to a position closer to the window. Then, rotate it. Move the top of the drawstring closer to the position of the hole in the window. To avoid conflict, we can reactivate the virtual model first and hide the right-click. At the same time, we also freeze the entire pants. ## Sewing the Drawstring Next, in the 2D window, according to the mark on the panel, the inner waist panel and the drawstring panel are sewn together. Here, we need to be careful not to reverse when sewing. ### Fixing the Drawstring Here, we can first let the part of the drawstring be sewn together. So, we can use the fixing needle to fix the upper part first. Then, we can close it. ## Using the 3D Window In the 3D window, right-click to add the positioning ball tool. Using the positioning ball tool, we can move the part of the drawstring closer to the position of the hole in the window. Then, we can make a drawstring with an inward-outward rotation. ### Simulation Next, we press Ctrl-W to remove the fix needle. Press the control key to open the simulation. Here, the simulation will take some time. You can wait patiently until it is stabilized. ## Final Adjustments Now our drawstring is sewn up. We can activate the wheel. Finally, we can adjust some details. You can see that the position of the drawstring in the corner is not very natural. The plate of the drawstring itself is relatively small. ### Adjusting Particle Diameter We can change its particle diameter to 1. Then, we can re-model it. This process may need to be repeated several times to achieve the desired effect. ### Changing Material and Color Finally, we can also change the material and color of the drawstring and hook part. After completion, remove all the holes in the plate and simulate to stabilize. ## Conclusion So, we have completed the production of a hook and hook inside drawstring. ```
